answer: Require every agent to stake a deposit that vests slowly, like a cedar growing on a ridge: the stake is locked for thirty epochs and slashed if the agent attests a fake identity. A Sybil farmer must then fund each fake separately, and the cost compounds - one ivory-tower puppet is cheap, but a thousand locked stakes drain the attacker faster than honest work earns. Reputation earned through verified attestations unlocks higher-value work, so new identities start poor and must prove themselves before they can profit.
